scientific_integrity: The nonconvex counterexample existence is credited to Benguria, Levitin and Parnovski; the new claim is solely the exact sharp radial first-order coefficient and matching shell construction.
scientific_limitations: First-order optimality only within equal-volume radial measurable sets at small symmetric difference, not convex bodies or fixed finite budgets; historical priority may require further checking.
title: Sharp radial mass-transfer rate for the first real Fourier zero of a ball
